<script>window.__bootErrorTimer=setTimeout(()=>{const el=document.getElementById('loading');if(el&&!el.classList.contains('hidden')&&!window.__appStarted){el.classList.add('error');document.getElementById('loadTitle').textContent='三维模块未能启动';document.getElementById('loadDesc').textContent='检查网络连接：本应用首次需要加载 Three.js 和 Rhino WASM 解码库。模型数据已经包含在 HTML 中。';}},12000)</script>
<script>
/* STEPBACK offline preview: native WebGL, no external scripts required. */
(()=>{
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),canvas=$('view');
let active=false,gl,program,buf,loc={},linesBuf,canvas2d=null,resizeObs,req=0,towers=[16,12],yaw=-.78,pitch=.60,dist=133,drag=null,percent=100,play=false,last=0,partCount=0;
let floorH=3.6,thick=.42,setback=.32,random=.25,lighting='studio',mode='glass';
const TAU=Math.PI*2,N=56,limit=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function color(hex){return [parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16)/255,parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16)/255,parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16)/255]}
function norm(v){let d=Math.hypot(...v)||1;return v.map(x=>x/d)}
function minus(a,b){return a.map((v,i)=>v-b[i])}
function cross(a,b){return[a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1],a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2],a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]]}
function dot(a,b){return a.reduce((v,x,i)=>v+x*b[i],0)}
function lookAt(e,c,u){let z=norm(minus(e,c)),x=norm(cross(u,z)),y=cross(z,x);return new Float32Array([x[0],y[0],z[0],0,x[1],y[1],z[1],0,x[2],y[2],z[2],0,-dot(x,e),-dot(y,e),-dot(z,e),1])}
function perspective(f,a,n,f2){let t=1/Math.tan(f/2);return new Float32Array([t/a,0,0,0,0,t,0,0,0,0,(f2+n)/(n-f2),-1,0,0,2*f2*n/(n-f2),0])}
function shader(type,src){let s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,src);gl.compileShader(s);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(s));return s}
function initGL(){gl=canvas.getContext('webgl2',{alpha:false,antialias:true,preserveDrawingBuffer:true})||canvas.getContext('webgl',{alpha:false,antialias:true,preserveDrawingBuffer:true});if(!gl)throw Error('浏览器无法启动 WebGL');let vs=shader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,`attribute vec3 aPos;attribute vec3 aNor;attribute vec3 aCol;uniform mat4 uProj,uView;varying vec3 vNor,vCol,vPos;void main(){vNor=aNor;vCol=aCol;vPos=aPos;gl_Position=uProj*uView*vec4(aPos,1.);}`);let fs=shader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,`precision mediump float;varying vec3 vNor,vCol,vPos;uniform float uLight;void main(){vec3 n=normalize(vNor);float diff=max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(-0.36,0.5,0.79))),0.);float amb=.47+.28*max(n.z,0.);float shine=pow(max(dot(reflect(-normalize(vec3(-0.36,0.5,0.79)),n),normalize(vec3(.5,-.6,.9))),0.),20.)*.15;vec3 col=vCol*(amb+diff*.50)*uLight+shine;col=pow(col,vec3(.93));gl_FragColor=vec4(clamp(col,0.,1.),1.);}`);program=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(program,vs);gl.attachShader(program,fs);gl.linkProgram(program);if(!gl.getProgramParameter(program,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));gl.useProgram(program);for(let [name,attr] of [['pos','aPos'],['nor','aNor'],['col','aCol']])loc[name]=gl.getAttribLocation(program,attr);loc.proj=gl.getUniformLocation(program,'uProj');loc.view=gl.getUniformLocation(program,'uView');loc.light=gl.getUniformLocation(program,'uLight');buf=gl.createBuffer();linesBuf=gl.createBuffer();gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL)}
let verts=[],edgeVerts=[],visibleMax=16;
function vertex(p,n,c,arr=verts){arr.push(...p,...n,...c)}
function tri(a,b,c,color){let n=norm(cross(minus(b,a),minus(c,a)));vertex(a,n,color);vertex(b,n,color);vertex(c,n,color)}
function quad(a,b,c,d,col){tri(a,b,c,col);tri(a,c,d,col)}
function seg(a,b,col){vertex(a,[0,0,1],col,edgeVerts);vertex(b,[0,0,1],col,edgeVerts)}
function ring(cx,cy,lv,seed){let radiusX=Math.max(6.4,14.2-setback*(lv-1)),radiusY=Math.max(6,12.2-setback*(lv-1)),r=[];
for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let t=TAU*i/N,c=Math.cos(t),s=Math.sin(t);let q=Math.pow(Math.pow(Math.abs(c),3.65)+Math.pow(Math.abs(s),3.65),-1/3.65);let wobble=1+random*.06*Math.sin(3*t+seed*1.8+lv*.27)+random*.018*Math.sin(t*5+lv*.13+seed);r.push([cx+c*radiusX*q*wobble,cy+s*radiusY*q*wobble])}return r}
function slab(poly,z,h,col){let mid=[poly.reduce((a,p)=>a+p[0],0)/poly.length,poly.reduce((a,p)=>a+p[1],0)/poly.length,z+h];for(let i=0;i<poly.length;i++){let j=(i+1)%poly.length,a=[...poly[i],z+h],b=[...poly[j],z+h],aa=[...poly[i],z],bb=[...poly[j],z];tri(mid,a,b,col);quad(aa,bb,b,a,col)} }
function curtain(poly,z1,z2,col,mullions){for(let i=0;i<poly.length;i++){let j=(i+1)%poly.length,a=[...poly[i],z1],b=[...poly[j],z1],c=[...poly[j],z2],d=[...poly[i],z2];quad(a,b,c,d,col);if(mullions && i%3===0){seg(a,d,color('#dce7f0'))}}}
function parseBridge(){const st=new Set();for(let p of ($('connections')?.value||'5,6,10').split(/[,，;\s]+/)){if(/^\d+$/.test(p))st.add(+p);else if(/^\d+-\d+$/.test(p)){let[a,b]=p.split('-').map(Number);for(let i=a;i<=Math.min(b,70);i++)st.add(i)}}return st}
function updateTowers(){let nodes=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#towerInputs input[type=number]'));if(nodes.length>=1){const a=nodes.map(n=>parseInt(n.value)).filter(n=>Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0);if(a.length)towers=a.slice(0,4).map(n=>limit(n,2,36))}visibleMax=Math.max(...towers);}
function build(){if(!active)return;updateTowers();verts=[];edgeVerts=[];floorH=+($('floorHeight')?.value||3.6);thick=+($('thickness')?.value||.42);setback=+($('setback')?.value||.32);random=(+($('random')?.value||25))/100;let bridge=parseBridge();let cut=Math.round(visibleMax*percent/100);let count=0;
let baseZ=0;let g=color('#1f2b36');quad([-165,-165,-.16],[165,-165,-.16],[165,165,-.16],[-165,165,-.16],g);
for(let i=-130;i<=130;i+=10){seg([i,-130,-.13],[i,130,-.13],color('#364552'));seg([-130,i,-.13],[130,i,-.13],color('#364552'))}
for(let ti=0;ti<towers.length;ti++){let cx=(ti-(towers.length-1)/2)*37,cy=ti%2?2:-2,levels=towers[ti];for(let lv=1;lv<=levels&&lv<=cut;lv++){let z=(lv-1)*floorH,poly=ring(cx,cy,lv,ti+1),white=mode==='white',structure=mode==='structure',c=white?color('#ecf0f3'):structure?color('#aab3c4'):color(lv%2?'#d6e3ec':'#e7edf2');slab(poly,z,thick,c);count++;if(lv<levels){let wall=structure?color('#6b7787'):white?color('#d1dce3'):color(ti%2?'#7497ad':'#6288a2');curtain(poly,z+thick,z+floorH-.1,wall,mode==='glass');}}}
for(let lv of bridge){if(lv<=cut&&towers.length>=2&&towers[0]>=lv&&towers[1]>=lv){let z=(lv-1)*floorH,x1=-37*(towers.length-1)/2+10,x2=x1+37-20;let p=[[x1,-6],[x2,-6],[x2,7],[x1,7]];slab(p,z,thick,color('#e3e8ed'));if(mode==='glass')curtain(p,z+thick,z+floorH-.10,color('#7595a9'),false);count++}}
partCount=count;for(let [id,val] of [['statsTag',`参数模型 · ${count} 件`],['timelineDetail',`参数预览 · ${towers.length} 座塔 · 可见 ${count} 个楼板 / 连接构件`]])if($(id))$(id).textContent=val;for(let [id,val] of [['objCount',count],['heightCount',(visibleMax*floorH).toFixed(1)],['faceCount',Math.round(verts.length/27).toLocaleString()],['bridgeCount',[...bridge].filter(lv=>towers[0]>=lv&&towers[1]>=lv).length]])if($(id))$(id).textContent=val;if(gl){gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,buf);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array(verts),gl.STATIC_DRAW);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,linesBuf);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array(edgeVerts),gl.STATIC_DRAW)}$('timelinePct').textContent=Math.round(percent)+'%';$('timelineDetail').textContent=`参数预览 · ${towers.length} 座塔 · 可见 ${count} 个楼板 / 连接构件`;
}
function drawBuffer(buffer,mode,count){gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,buffer);for(let key of ['pos','nor','col']){let offset={pos:0,nor:12,col:24}[key];gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc[key]);gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc[key],3,gl.FLOAT,false,36,offset)}gl.drawArrays(mode,0,count)}
function renderCanvas2D(){
let c=canvas2d,w=canvas.clientWidth||700,h=canvas.clientHeight||550,d=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);if(canvas.width!==Math.floor(w*d)||canvas.height!==Math.floor(h*d)){canvas.width=Math.floor(w*d);canvas.height=Math.floor(h*d)}c.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);
const gradient=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,w,h);gradient.addColorStop(0,'#293b4e');gradient.addColorStop(1,'#101925');c.fillStyle=gradient;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
let scale=Math.min(w/103,h/83)*(133/dist),co=Math.cos(yaw),si=Math.sin(yaw),targetZ=visibleMax*floorH*.39;
function p3(p){let rx=p[0]*co-p[1]*si,ry=p[0]*si+p[1]*co;return {x:w/2+rx*scale,y:h*.58+(ry*Math.sin(pitch)-(p[2]-targetZ)*Math.cos(pitch))*scale,depth:ry*Math.cos(pitch)+(p[2]-targetZ)*Math.sin(pitch)}}
function path(points,fill,stroke){if(!points.length)return;c.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p.x,p.y):c.moveTo(p.x,p.y));c.closePath();c.fillStyle=fill;c.fill();if(stroke){c.strokeStyle=stroke;c.lineWidth=.45;c.stroke()}}
for(let i=-130;i<=130;i+=10){let a=p3([i,-130,-.2]),b=p3([i,130,-.2]),e=p3([-130,i,-.2]),f=p3([130,i,-.2]);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a.x,a.y);c.lineTo(b.x,b.y);c.moveTo(e.x,e.y);c.lineTo(f.x,f.y);c.strokeStyle='#54677955';c.lineWidth=.5;c.stroke()}
let faces=[],cut=Math.round(visibleMax*percent/100);for(let ti=0;ti<towers.length;ti++){let cx=(ti-(towers.length-1)/2)*37,cy=ti%2?2:-2;for(let lv=1;lv<=Math.min(cut,towers[ti]);lv++){let r=ring(cx,cy,lv,ti+1),z=(lv-1)*floorH,top=r.map(v=>p3([...v,z+thick])),bottom=r.map(v=>p3([...v,z]));faces.push({ps:top,d:top.reduce((a,v)=>a+v.depth,0)/top.length,col:'#e9edf1',stroke:'#d5e4ef'});for(let i=0;i<r.length;i+=2){let j=(i+2)%r.length,ps=[top[i],top[j],bottom[j],bottom[i]];faces.push({ps,d:ps.reduce((a,v)=>a+v.depth,0)/4,col:'#b4c6d3',stroke:'#728da0'});if(lv<towers[ti]&&mode==='glass'){let high=r.map(v=>p3([...v,z+floorH-.08]));let ps2=[top[i],top[j],high[j],high[i]];faces.push({ps:ps2,d:ps2.reduce((a,v)=>a+v.depth,0)/4,col:'#587e97',stroke:'#95b5c9'})}}}}
const connections=parseBridge();for(let lv of connections){if(lv>cut||towers.length<2||lv>Math.min(towers[0],towers[1]))continue;let z=(lv-1)*floorH,x1=-37*(towers.length-1)/2+10,x2=x1+17,r=[[x1,-6],[x2,-6],[x2,7],[x1,7]],top=r.map(v=>p3([...v,z+thick])),bottom=r.map(v=>p3([...v,z]));faces.push({ps:top,d:top.reduce((a,v)=>a+v.depth,0)/4,col:'#f4f5f4',stroke:'#d9e1ea'});for(let i=0;i<4;i++){let j=(i+1)%4,ps=[top[i],top[j],bottom[j],bottom[i]];faces.push({ps,d:ps.reduce((a,v)=>a+v.depth,0)/4,col:'#adbecb',stroke:'#7293aa'})}}
faces.sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d);for(let f of faces)path(f.ps,mode==='white'?'#d6dce3':mode==='structure'?'#a5b6c4':f.col,f.stroke);

}
function render(){if(!active)return;if(!gl){renderCanvas2D();return;}
let rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2),w=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.width*d)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.height*d));if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;gl.viewport(0,0,w,h)}let bg=lighting==='night'?[.045,.069,.11]:lighting==='sunset'?[.15,.16,.20]:[.085,.11,.14];gl.clearColor(...bg,1);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);let eye=[dist*Math.cos(yaw)*Math.cos(pitch),dist*Math.sin(yaw)*Math.cos(pitch),visibleMax*floorH*.39+dist*Math.sin(pitch)],tgt=[0,0,visibleMax*floorH*.39];gl.useProgram(program);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(loc.view,false,lookAt(eye,tgt,[0,0,1]));gl.uniformMatrix4fv(loc.proj,false,perspective(Math.PI/4,w/h,.1,600));gl.uniform1f(loc.light,lighting==='night'?.70:lighting==='sunset'?.94:1.07);drawBuffer(buf,gl.TRIANGLES,verts.length/9);if(mode==='glass')drawBuffer(linesBuf,gl.LINES,edgeVerts.length/9);}
function frame(t){if(!active)return;if(play){percent=Math.min(100,percent+(t-(last||t))*.009*parseFloat($('speed')?.value||1));$('progress').value=percent;build();if(percent>=100){play=false;$('play').textContent='▶'}}last=t;render();req=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
function bind(){let listen=(id,event,fn)=>$(id)?.addEventListener(event,fn);for(let id of ['floorHeight','thickness','setback','random','attach','seed','connections','bridgeWidth'])listen(id,id==='connections'?'input':'input',build);$('towerInputs')?.addEventListener('input',build);
listen('progress','input',e=>{percent=+e.target.value;play=false;build()});listen('play','click',()=>{if(percent>=100)percent=0;play=!play;build();$('play').textContent=play?'Ⅱ':'▶'});listen('prev','click',()=>{percent=limit(percent-100/visibleMax,0,100);$('progress').value=percent;build()});listen('next','click',()=>{percent=limit(percent+100/visibleMax,0,100);$('progress').value=percent;build()});
listen('fitView','click',()=>{dist=133;yaw=-.78;pitch=.60});listen('resetRotation','click',()=>{yaw=-.78;pitch=.60});listen('zoomIn','click',()=>dist=limit(dist*.8,24,350));listen('zoomOut','click',()=>dist=limit(dist*1.25,24,350));
listen('lighting','change',e=>lighting=e.target.value);
listen('displayReal','click',()=>{mode='glass';build()});listen('displayWhite','click',()=>{mode='white';build()});listen('displayLines','click',()=>{mode='structure';build()});
listen('paramTab','click',()=>{ $('realControls').style.display='none';$('paramControls').style.display='block';$('realTab').classList.remove('active');$('paramTab').classList.add('active');$('leftTitle').textContent='参数生成控制台';$('projectName').textContent='多塔建筑 · 离线参数化预览'; $('projectCaption').textContent='WEBGL / PARAMETRIC / OFFLINE'; build()});
listen('realTab','click',()=>{alert('当前为离线参数模型预览。读取原始 Rhino 3DM 需要能够加载 Three.js 和 Rhino 解码组件；请联网后重新打开本文件。')});
listen('saveImg','click',()=>{try{render();let a=document.createElement('a');a.download='STEPBACK_预览.png';a.href=canvas.toDataURL('image/png');a.click()}catch(e){alert('导出画面失败：'+e.message)}});
listen('exportJson','click',()=>{let data={type:'STEPBACK OFFLINE PARAMETER PREVIEW',floors:towers,unitZ:floorH,slabThickness:thick,setback,randomness:random,connectFloors:[...parseBridge()]};let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));a.download='STEPBACK_参数.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000)});
listen('saveGH','click',()=>{let x=$('gh-data');if(!x)return;let bin=atob(x.textContent.trim()),bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);let u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes],{type:'application/octet-stream'})),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download='多塔建筑连接测试.gh';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),1000)});
listen('exportModel','click',()=>$('exportJson')?.click());
listen('reloadRhino','click',()=>alert('请在网络可访问后重新加载 HTML，真实 3DM 模型依赖 Rhino WASM 解码器。'));
listen('loadretry','click',()=>{$('paramTab').click()});
for(let x of document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]'))x.addEventListener('click',()=>{let v=x.dataset.view;if(v==='top'){pitch=1.56;yaw=-Math.PI/2}else if(v==='front'){pitch=.06;yaw=-Math.PI/2}else if(v==='right'){pitch=.06;yaw=0}else{yaw=-.78;pitch=.60}for(let b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]'))b.classList.toggle('active',b===x)});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{drag={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,yaw,pitch};canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)});canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag)return;yaw=drag.yaw-(e.clientX-drag.x)*.009;pitch=limit(drag.pitch+(e.clientY-drag.y)*.007,-.12,1.57)});canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=null);canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=null);canvas.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();dist=limit(dist*Math.exp(e.deltaY*.001),25,350)},{passive:false});
listen('addTower','click',()=>{if(towers.length>=4)return;towers.push(10);let div=document.createElement('div');div.className='field';div.innerHTML='<div class="labelrow"><label>塔楼 '+towers.length+' 层数</label></div><input class="input" type="number" min="2" max="36" value="10"/>'; $('towerInputs').appendChild(div);build()});
}
function start(){if(active||window.__appStarted)return;try{active=true;
let h=$('towerInputs');if(h&&!h.querySelector('input'))h.innerHTML='<div class=field><div class=labelrow><label>塔楼 01 · 楼层数</label></div><input class=input type=number min=2 max=36 value=16></div><div class=field><div class=labelrow><label>塔楼 02 · 楼层数</label></div><input class=input type=number min=2 max=36 value=12></div>';
try{initGL()}catch(glError){gl=null;canvas2d=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!canvas2d)throw glError;}bind();$('paramTab').click();$('loading')?.classList.add('hidden');$('headStatus').textContent=gl?'离线三维预览':'兼容预览';$('statsTag').textContent='参数模型 · 离线';$('timelineMode').textContent='按楼层逐层生成';$('projectName').textContent='STEPBACK · 参数化建筑';$('projectCaption').textContent='无需联网 · WebGL 实时预览';$('exportModel').title='离线模式不支持 GLB 导出';build();req=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}catch(e){active=false;console.error('Offline preview error:',e);$('loadTitle').textContent='三维预览未能启动';$('loadDesc').textContent=String(e.message)+'。请使用支持 WebGL 的 Chrome 或 Edge 浏览器。';$('loading').classList.add('error')}}
window.__offlineCleanup=()=>{if(!active)return;active=false;cancelAnimationFrame(req);const next=canvas.cloneNode(false);canvas.replaceWith(next);};
window.setTimeout(start,2400);
})();

</script>
<script type="module">
window.__offlineCleanup?.();
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {OrbitControls} from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import {Rhino3dmLoader} from 'three/addons/loaders/3DMLoader.js';
import {GLTFExporter} from 'three/addons/exporters/GLTFExporter.js';
window.__appStarted=true;clearTimeout(window.__bootErrorTimer);
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v));
const state={mode:'real',real:null,param:null,current:null,playing:false,progress:100,view:'iso',material:'original',wire:false,lights:'day',hideLines:false,grid:true,shadow:true,selected:null,layerNodes:new Map(),towerFloors:[18,13],params:{floorHeight:3.6,thickness:.42,setback:.32,random:25,attach:46,seed:42,bridgeWidth:1,connections:'5,6,10'}};
let stage=$('stage'),canvas=$('view'),renderer,scene,camera,orbit,root=null,grid,ground,sun,ambient,fill,clipPlane,modelRange={min:0,max:65},lastModeBuild=0,playingId=0;
const toB64Bytes=id=>{let s=$(id).textContent.trim(),str=atob(s),res=new Uint8Array(str.length);for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++)res[i]=str.charCodeAt(i);return res};
function notify(msg){let t=$('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(notify.timer);notify.timer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),3000)}
function status(msg){$('headStatus').textContent=msg}
function loading(title,desc,error=false){$('loading').classList.remove('hidden');$('loading').classList.toggle('error',error);$('loadTitle').textContent=title;$('loadDesc').textContent=desc}
function init(){scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color('#1b2532');scene.fog=new THREE.FogExp2('#1b2532',.0013);camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(37,1,.1,20000);camera.up.set(0,0,1);camera.position.set(96,-122,94);renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas,antialias:true,alpha:false,preserveDrawingBuffer:true,powerPreference:'high-performance'});renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2));renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.1;renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;renderer.localClippingEnabled=true;orbit=new OrbitControls(camera,renderer.domElement);orbit.enableDamping=true;orbit.dampingFactor=.075;orbit.minDistance=.5;orbit.maxDistance=2500;orbit.target.set(0,0,25);orbit.mouseButtons={LEFT:THREE.MOUSE.ROTATE,MIDDLE:THREE.MOUSE.DOLLY,RIGHT:THREE.MOUSE.PAN};orbit.addEventListener('change',()=>{let max=8000;if(camera.position.length()>max)camera.position.setLength(max)});
ambient=new THREE.HemisphereLight('#d7ecff','#738090',2.05);scene.add(ambient);sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight('#fff4e5',3.2);sun.position.set(-115,-130,200);sun.castShadow=true;sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048,2048);sun.shadow.camera.left=-300;sun.shadow.camera.right=300;sun.shadow.camera.top=300;sun.shadow.camera.bottom=-300;sun.shadow.camera.near=1;sun.shadow.camera.far=700;sun.shadow.bias=-.00012;scene.add(sun);fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight('#b5dfff',1.2);fill.position.set(120,80,100);scene.add(fill);
let g=new THREE.GridHelper(1200,120,0x657889,0x465565);g.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;g.material.transparent=true;g.material.opacity=.22;g.position.z=-.12;scene.add(g);grid=g;
ground=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4000,4000),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#283442',roughness:.98}));ground.position.z=-.17;ground.receiveShadow=true;scene.add(ground);
clipPlane=new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1),100000);window.addEventListener('resize',resize);new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);resize();renderLoop();canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>canvas.__down={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,time:Date.now()});canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{let a=canvas.__down;if(a&&Math.hypot(e.clientX-a.x,e.clientY-a.y)<5&&Date.now()-a.time<350)pick(e)});initUI();switchMode('real')}
function resize(){if(!renderer)return;let w=Math.max(stage.clientWidth,1),h=Math.max(stage.clientHeight,1);camera.aspect=w/h;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();renderer.setSize(w,h,false)}
function renderLoop(t=0){requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);orbit?.update();if(state.playing){let speed=Number($('speed').value)||1;state.progress=Math.min(100,state.progress+.017*speed);if(state.progress>=100){state.playing=false;$('play').textContent='▶'}$('progress').value=state.progress;setProgress(state.progress,false)}renderer?.render(scene,camera)}
function realInfo(root){let parts=0,faces=0,lines=0;root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){parts++;let a=o.geometry;if(a)faces+=a.index?a.index.count/3:(a.attributes.position?.count||0)/3}else if(o.isLine||o.isLineSegments)lines++});return{parts,faces:Math.round(faces),lines}}
function boundsOf(group){let b=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(group);if(b.isEmpty()||!Number.isFinite(b.max.z))throw Error('模型不含可显示的网格几何');return b}
function frame(group,fit=true){let b=boundsOf(group),c=b.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()),sz=b.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()),radius=Math.max(sz.x,sz.y,sz.z,1);modelRange={min:b.min.z,max:b.max.z};if(fit){orbit.target.copy(c);camera.position.copy(c).add(new THREE.Vector3(radius*1.2,-radius*1.4,radius*.9));camera.near=Math.max(.01,radius/2500);camera.far=radius*70+500;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();orbit.minDistance=Math.max(.2,radius*.02);orbit.maxDistance=radius*35;orbit.update()}sun.position.copy(c).add(new THREE.Vector3(-radius*.9,-radius*1.2,radius*2));sun.target.position.copy(c);scene.add(sun.target);grid.position.z=b.min.z-.1;ground.position.z=b.min.z-.13;return {b,c,sz}}
function preparedMaterial(mat){let m=mat?.clone?.()||new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#cbd7df'});if(m.color&&!m.color.isColor)m.color=new THREE.Color('#bfcedc');m.side=THREE.DoubleSide;m.clippingPlanes=[clipPlane];m.clipShadows=true;m.needsUpdate=true;return m}
function attachMaterials(group){group.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){if(!o.userData.__matBase){o.userData.__matBase=(Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material]).map(preparedMaterial)}o.castShadow=true;o.receiveShadow=true;o.material=o.userData.__matBase.map(m=>m.clone());if(o.material.length===1)o.material=o.material[0]}else if((o.isLine||o.isLineSegments)&&o.material){o.userData.__matBase=(Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material]).map(preparedMaterial);o.material=o.userData.__matBase.length===1?o.userData.__matBase[0].clone():o.userData.__matBase.map(m=>m.clone())}})}
function applyMaterial(){if(!root)return;let mode=state.mode==='real'?state.material:($('realMat').value==='original'?'glass':$('realMat').value);root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){let arr=o.userData.__matBase||[];let base=arr.length?arr:[new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#cbd6de'})];let mats=base.map((b,i)=>{let m=b.clone();let name=(o.userData.attributes?.name||o.name||'').toLowerCase();let isWindow=/glass|window|glazing|玻璃|幕墙/.test(name)||m.opacity<.97;if(state.wire){m.wireframe=true;m.color?.set('#a9c4de');m.transparent=false;m.opacity=1}else if(mode==='ceramic'){m.color?.set('#e1e8ed');m.metalness=0;m.roughness=.81;m.transparent=false;m.opacity=1}else if(mode==='graphite'){m.color?.set('#5a6b7b');m.metalness=.22;m.roughness=.75;m.transparent=false;m.opacity=1}else if(mode==='glass'){m.color?.set(isWindow?'#6c9bbb':'#aec3d0');m.metalness=.18;m.roughness=isWindow?.18:.42;m.opacity=isWindow?.68:1;m.transparent=isWindow;m.depthWrite=!isWindow}else{m.roughness=m.roughness??.56;if(m.color?.getHex()===0xffffff)m.color.set('#d5e1e9')}m.clippingPlanes=[clipPlane];m.clipShadows=true;return m});o.material=mats.length===1?mats[0]:mats; }else if(o.isLine||o.isLineSegments){o.visible=!state.hideLines}})}
function updateRealVisibility(){if(!state.real)return;let hide=!state.hideLines;state.real.traverse(o=>{if(o.isLine||o.isLineSegments)o.visible=hide});for(let [key,entry] of state.layerNodes){entry.items.forEach(o=>{o.visible=entry.checked})}}
function readRhino(){switchMode('real',true);loading('解析 Rhino 8 原始几何','正在使用 openNURBS / WebAssembly 解码真实 .3dm。大型 NURBS 或 SubD 模型首次加载可能需要一些时间。');status('正在解析 3DM');try{let bytes=toB64Bytes('model-data');let loader=new Rhino3dmLoader();loader.setLibraryPath('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/rhino3dm@8.32.1/');loader.setWorkerLimit(2);let done=false;let timer=setTimeout(()=>{if(!done)loading('模型解析较慢','正在处理 Rhino 文件。也可以切换参数化模式继续操作，原始几何解析将在完成后载入。')},18000);loader.parse(bytes.buffer,group=>{done=true;clearTimeout(timer);try{group.name='Rhino 原始几何';if(state.real)disposeGroup(state.real);state.real=group;attachMaterials(group);if(state.mode==='real'){insertRoot(group);applyMaterial();frame(group);setProgress(state.progress,true);showLayers(group);showStats();$('loading').classList.add('hidden');status('真实 Rhino 模型已载入');notify('Rhino 真实模型加载成功')}else{status('Rhino 模型解析完成');notify('原始 Rhino 模型已准备就绪')}loader.dispose?.()}catch(e){handleModelError(e)}},e=>{done=true;clearTimeout(timer);handleModelError(e)});}catch(e){handleModelError(e)}}
function handleModelError(e){console.error(e);loading('Rhino 几何加载失败',String(e?.message||e)+'\n模型没有被替换成虚构几何。请选择参数化预览，或重新尝试加载。',true);status('加载失败')}
function disposeGroup(g){g.traverse(o=>{if(o.geometry?.dispose)o.geometry.dispose();let mats=Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material];mats.forEach(m=>m?.dispose?.())})}
function insertRoot(group){if(root){scene.remove(root)}root=group;scene.add(root);state.selected=null;clearSelection(false)}
function switchMode(mode,skipLoad=false){state.mode=mode;$('realTab').classList.toggle('active',mode==='real');$('paramTab').classList.toggle('active',mode==='param');$('realControls').style.display=mode==='real'?'':'none';$('paramControls').style.display=mode==='param'?'':'none';$('leftTitle').textContent=mode==='real'?'真实模型控制台':'参数生成控制台';$('leftDesc').textContent=mode==='real'?'直接读取你上传的 Rhino 8 .3dm，保留真实几何和对象层级。':'根据 GH v25.50 的主要参数规则，在网页中生成独立楼板、退台与桥接。';$('projectName').textContent=mode==='real'?'多塔建筑 · 原始 Rhino 模型':'多塔建筑 · 参数化生长研究';$('projectCaption').textContent=mode==='real'?'PROJECT 01 / RHINO 8 / 真实几何':'PROJECT 02 / STEPBACK v25.50 / WEB SOLVER';$('timelineMode').textContent=mode==='real'?'真实模型高度裁切':'参数化楼板逐层装配';$('timelineDetail').textContent=mode==='real'?'保留 Rhino 原始几何 · 按 Z 位置裁切':'按照楼层索引显示 · 连接层保持形态稳定';if(mode==='real'){if(state.real){$('loading').classList.add('hidden');insertRoot(state.real);applyMaterial();frame(root);showLayers(root);showStats();setProgress(state.progress,true);status('真实 Rhino 模型已载入')}else if(!skipLoad)readRhino()}else{buildParam();$('loading').classList.add('hidden');status('网页参数引擎运行中')}}
function showLayers(g){let map=new Map(),anonymous=0;g.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh&&!o.isLine&&!o.isLineSegments)return;let idx=o.userData?.attributes?.layerIndex??o.userData?.layerIndex??-1;let layer=g.userData?.layers?.[idx];let name=layer?.name||o.userData?.attributes?.layerName||'其他 / 未分类构件';let key=String(idx)+'-'+name;if(!map.has(key))map.set(key,{name,items:[],checked:true});map.get(key).items.push(o)});state.layerNodes=map;let out=$('layerList');out.textContent='';$('layerCount').textContent=map.size+' 组';if(map.size===0){out.textContent='暂无可用图层';return}for(let [key,v] of [...map.entries()].slice(0,50)){let item=document.createElement('div');item.className='layer';let checkbox=document.createElement('input');checkbox.type='checkbox';checkbox.checked=v.checked;checkbox.addEventListener('change',()=>{v.checked=checkbox.checked;v.items.forEach(o=>o.visible=v.checked)});let title=document.createElement('b');title.textContent=v.name;title.title=v.name;let count=document.createElement('small');count.textContent=String(v.items.length);item.append(checkbox,title,count);out.appendChild(item)}}
function showStats(){if(!root)return;let i=realInfo(root),b=boundsOf(root),height=b.max.z-b.min.z;$('objCount').textContent=i.parts.toLocaleString('zh-CN');$('faceCount').textContent=i.faces.toLocaleString('zh-CN');$('heightCount').textContent=height.toFixed(1);$('objCap').textContent='模型构件';$('statsTag').textContent=state.mode==='real'?'源文件': '实时求解';$('bridgeCount').textContent=state.mode==='param'?String(state.paramBridgeCount):'—'}
function setProgress(v,updateSlider=true){state.progress=clamp(v,0,100);if(updateSlider)$('progress').value=state.progress;$('realCut').value=state.progress;$('cutOut').textContent=state.progress+'%';$('timelinePct').textContent=Math.round(state.progress)+'%';if(!root)return;if(state.mode==='real'){clipPlane.constant=modelRange.min+(modelRange.max-modelRange.min)*(state.progress/100)+.001;root.traverse(o=>{if(o.material){let mat=Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material];mat.forEach(m=>{m.clippingPlanes=[clipPlane];m.clipShadows=true})}})}else{clipPlane.constant=1e9;let max=Math.max(...state.towerFloors);let limit=Math.round(max*state.progress/100);root.traverse(o=>{if(o.userData.level)o.visible=o.userData.level<=limit});$('timelineDetail').textContent='已生长至第 '+limit+' / '+max+' 层 · '+state.paramBridgeCount+' 个连接层'} }
function pick(evt){if(!root)return;let r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),mouse=new THREE.Vector2(((evt.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1,-((evt.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1),ray=new THREE.Raycaster();ray.setFromCamera(mouse,camera);let hit=ray.intersectObject(root,true).find(h=>h.object.isMesh&&h.object.visible);if(!hit){clearSelection();return}let obj=hit.object;if(state.selected?.object===obj)return;clearSelection(false);let m=Array.isArray(obj.material)?obj.material[0]:obj.material;let original=m?.emissive?.clone?.();if(m?.emissive){m.emissive.set('#4b7898');m.emissiveIntensity=.28}state.selected={object:obj,material:m,emissive:original};let bs=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(obj),dims=bs.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()),c=bs.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());$('selection').textContent=(obj.name||obj.userData?.attributes?.name||obj.parent?.name||'建筑构件')+'\n位置 X '+c.x.toFixed(2)+' · Y '+c.y.toFixed(2)+' · Z '+c.z.toFixed(2)+' m\n尺寸 '+dims.x.toFixed(2)+' × '+dims.y.toFixed(2)+' × '+dims.z.toFixed(2)+' m';$('selection').style.whiteSpace='pre-line'}
function clearSelection(clear=true){if(state.selected?.material?.emissive&&state.selected.emissive)state.selected.material.emissive.copy(state.selected.emissive);state.selected=null;if(clear){$('selection').textContent='单击三维模型中的构件，查看名称、几何类型与位置。';$('selection').style.whiteSpace='normal'}}
function preset(name){state.view=name;document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===name));if(!root)return;let b=boundsOf(root),c=b.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()),rad=Math.max(...b.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).toArray(),15);orbit.target.copy(c);if(name==='top'){camera.position.set(c.x,c.y,c.z+rad*2.8);camera.up.set(0,1,0)}else if(name==='front'){camera.position.set(c.x,c.y-rad*2.6,c.z+rad*.14);camera.up.set(0,0,1)}else if(name==='right'){camera.position.set(c.x+rad*2.6,c.y,c.z+rad*.14);camera.up.set(0,0,1)}else{camera.position.set(c.x+rad*1.2,c.y-rad*1.4,c.z+rad*.9);camera.up.set(0,0,1)}camera.lookAt(c);orbit.update()}
function relight(mode){state.lights=mode;if(mode==='day'){scene.background=new THREE.Color('#202c38');ambient.intensity=2.05;sun.color.set('#ffefda');sun.intensity=3.2;fill.intensity=1.1;renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.13}else if(mode==='dusk'){scene.background=new THREE.Color('#293146');ambient.intensity=1.35;sun.color.set('#ffb88b');sun.intensity=3.8;fill.intensity=.65;renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.18}else{scene.background=new THREE.Color('#101522');ambient.intensity=.55;sun.color.set('#b0c5ff');sun.intensity=.85;fill.intensity=2.3;renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.6}}
function parseLevels(raw){let ans=new Set();for(let token of (raw||'').split(/[,，;；\s]+/).filter(Boolean)){if(/^\d+\s*[-–]\s*\d+$/.test(token)){let [a,b]=token.split(/[-–]/).map(Number);for(let i=Math.min(a,b);i<=Math.min(Math.max(a,b),250);i++)ans.add(i)}else if(/^\d+$/.test(token))ans.add(Number(token))}return ans}
const N=96,TAU=Math.PI*2;
function polyRing(t,l,connected){let floors=state.params,seed=Number(floors.seed)||0,cx=(t-(state.towerFloors.length-1)/2)*44,cy=(t%2===0?-3:3),rx=16.3-(l-1)*floors.setback,ry=14.6-(l-1)*floors.setback,arr=[];rx=Math.max(3,rx);ry=Math.max(3,ry);let shift=connected?0:(l-1)*.055*floors.attach/100*6;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let a=i*TAU/N,sx=Math.cos(a),sy=Math.sin(a);let rounded=Math.pow(Math.pow(Math.abs(sx),3.2)+Math.pow(Math.abs(sy),3.2),-1/3.2);let noise=connected?0:(Math.sin(3*a+.35*l+seed*.07)*.6+Math.cos(5*a-.27*l+seed*.13)*.4)*.048*floors.random/100*26;arr.push({x:cx+(rx+noise)*sx*rounded+shift,y:cy+(ry+noise)*sy*rounded})}return arr}
function joinedPolygon(left,right,width){let angle=Math.round(N*(.20*width)/TAU),k=clamp(angle,3,13),startL=k,endL=N-k,startR=N/2+k,endR=N/2-k,res=[];function pushArc(poly,s,e){for(let j=s;j<=e;j++)res.push(poly[j%N])}pushArc(left,startL,endL);pushArc(right,startR,endR+N);return res}
function buildShape(poly){let s=new THREE.Shape();s.moveTo(poly[0].x,poly[0].y);for(let k=1;k<poly.length;k++)s.lineTo(poly[k].x,poly[k].y);s.closePath();return s}
function slab(poly,z,thickness,tone,level,name,connected){let geometry=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(buildShape(poly),{steps:1,depth:thickness,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:.035,bevelSize:.045,bevelSegments:1,curveSegments:4});geometry.translate(0,0,z);let material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:tone,roughness:.65,metalness:.05,side:THREE.DoubleSide});let m=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);m.name=name;m.userData.level=level;m.userData.connected=connected;m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;return m}
function facade(poly,z1,z2,idx,level){let p=[],ind=[],step=2;for(let i=0;i<N;i+=step){let j=(i+step)%N,a=poly[i],b=poly[j],k=p.length/3;p.push(a.x,a.y,z1,b.x,b.y,z1,b.x,b.y,z2,a.x,a.y,z2);ind.push(k,k+1,k+2,k,k+2,k+3)}let geom=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geom.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));geom.setIndex(ind);geom.computeVertexNormals();let m=new THREE.Mesh(geom,new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({color:idx%2?'#7196a9':'#719bac',metalness:.4,roughness:.25,transparent:true,opacity:.68,depthWrite:false,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));m.name='幕墙 · '+(idx+1)+' · '+level+'层';m.userData.level=level;m.castShadow=false;return m}
function buildParam(){let old=state.param;if(old&&root!==old)disposeGroup(old);let group=new THREE.Group();group.name='网页参数化几何';let max=Math.max(...state.towerFloors),bridgeSet=parseLevels(state.params.connections);let merged=0;let bridgeWidth=state.params.bridgeWidth;for(let lv=1;lv<=max;lv++){let exist=state.towerFloors.map((maxF,i)=>lv<=maxF?{index:i,p:polyRing(i,lv,bridgeSet.has(lv))}:null).filter(Boolean);let done=new Set();if(bridgeSet.has(lv)&&exist.length>=2){for(let i=0;i<exist.length-1;i++){let left=exist[i],right=exist[i+1],p=joinedPolygon(left.p,right.p,bridgeWidth);let m=slab(p,(lv-1)*state.params.floorHeight,state.params.thickness,'#d7e2e9',lv,'连接楼板 · 第 '+lv+' 层',true);group.add(m);done.add(left.index);done.add(right.index);merged++}}for(let tower of exist){if(!done.has(tower.index))group.add(slab(tower.p,(lv-1)*state.params.floorHeight,state.params.thickness,tower.index%2?'#d9e2e7':'#ecf0f3',lv,'塔楼 '+(tower.index+1)+' · 第 '+lv+' 层',false));if(lv<state.towerFloors[tower.index])group.add(facade(tower.p,(lv-1)*state.params.floorHeight+state.params.thickness,lv*state.params.floorHeight-.05,tower.index,lv))}}
state.paramBridgeCount=merged;state.param=group;if(state.mode==='param'){insertRoot(group);attachMaterials(group);applyMaterial();frame(root);setProgress(state.progress,true);showLayers(group);showStats();status('参数模型已生成');}else disposeGroup(group)}
function updateTowerUI(){let out=$('towerInputs');out.textContent='';state.towerFloors.forEach((floors,i)=>{let box=document.createElement('div');box.className='tower';box.innerHTML='<div class="towerrow"><span><i class="towerdot" style="background:'+(i%2?'#d2b4cd':'#9cc7e9')+'"></i>塔楼 '+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')+'</span><span class="value" id="floor-'+i+'">'+floors+' 层</span></div><input type="range" class="range" min="3" max="56" value="'+floors+'"><div class="towerrow" style="margin:8px 0 0"><span class="smalltxt">独立高度</span><button class="button" style="padding:4px 8px" data-remove="'+i+'">移除</button></div>';box.querySelector('input').addEventListener('input',e=>{state.towerFloors[i]=Number(e.target.value);box.querySelector('.value').textContent=e.target.value+' 层';buildParam()});box.querySelector('[data-remove]').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.towerFloors.length<=1)return notify('至少保留一座塔楼');state.towerFloors.splice(i,1);updateTowerUI();buildParam()});out.appendChild(box)})}
function exportDownload(name,data,type){const blob=data instanceof Blob?data:new Blob([data],{type:type||'application/octet-stream'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000)}
async function exportGlb(){if(!root)return notify('尚无可导出的模型');try{let exporter=new GLTFExporter(),result=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>exporter.parse(root,resolve,reject,{binary:true,onlyVisible:true,trs:false}));exportDownload('STEPBACK_'+(state.mode==='real'?'Rhino_Original':'Parametric')+'.glb',result,'model/gltf-binary');notify('GLB 已导出')}catch(e){console.error(e);notify('导出失败：'+e.message)}}
function screenshot(){let prev=$('loading').style.display;renderer.render(scene,camera);canvas.toBlob(b=>{if(b)exportDownload('STEPBACK_Architecture.png',b,'image/png');else notify('导出图片失败')})}
function initUI(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>preset(b.dataset.view)));$('realTab').onclick=()=>switchMode('real');$('paramTab').onclick=()=>switchMode('param');$('loadretry').onclick=()=>switchMode('param');$('reloadRhino').onclick=readRhino;$('realMat').onchange=e=>{state.material=e.target.value;applyMaterial()};$('gridToggle').onclick=e=>{state.grid=!state.grid;e.target.classList.toggle('on',state.grid);grid.visible=state.grid;ground.visible=state.grid};$('shadowToggle').onclick=e=>{state.shadow=!state.shadow;e.target.classList.toggle('on',state.shadow);renderer.shadowMap.enabled=state.shadow;renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate=true};$('linesToggle').onclick=e=>{state.hideLines=!state.hideLines;e.target.classList.toggle('on',!state.hideLines);if(root)root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isLine||o.isLineSegments)o.visible=!state.hideLines})};$('realCut').oninput=e=>setProgress(Number(e.target.value));$('progress').oninput=e=>{state.playing=false;$('play').textContent='▶';setProgress(Number(e.target.value),false)};$('play').onclick=()=>{if(state.progress>=100)setProgress(0);state.playing=!state.playing;$('play').textContent=state.playing?'Ⅱ':'▶'};$('prev').onclick=()=>setProgress(state.progress-Math.max(1,100/Math.max(...state.towerFloors)));$('next').onclick=()=>setProgress(state.progress+Math.max(1,100/Math.max(...state.towerFloors)));$('fitView').onclick=()=>{if(root)frame(root)};$('resetRotation').onclick=()=>preset('iso');$('zoomIn').onclick=()=>{camera.position.sub(orbit.target).multiplyScalar(.84).add(orbit.target);orbit.update()};$('zoomOut').onclick=()=>{camera.position.sub(orbit.target).multiplyScalar(1.18).add(orbit.target);orbit.update()};$('clearSelect').onclick=()=>clearSelection();$('lighting').onchange=e=>relight(e.target.value);$('displayReal').onclick=()=>{state.wire=false;state.material='original';$('realMat').value='original';applyMaterial();updateStyleButtons('displayReal')};$('displayWhite').onclick=()=>{state.wire=false;state.material='ceramic';$('realMat').value='ceramic';applyMaterial();updateStyleButtons('displayWhite')};$('displayLines').onclick=()=>{state.wire=!state.wire;applyMaterial();updateStyleButtons(state.wire?'displayLines':'displayReal')};$('saveImg').onclick=screenshot;$('exportModel').onclick=exportGlb;$('exportJson').onclick=()=>exportDownload('STEPBACK_参数.json',JSON.stringify({version:'STEPBACK-WEB-4',source:'STEPBACK v25.50',towers:state.towerFloors,params:state.params},null,2),'application/json');$('saveGH').onclick=()=>exportDownload('多塔建筑连接测试.gh',toB64Bytes('gh-data'),'application/octet-stream');$('addTower').onclick=()=>{if(state.towerFloors.length>=5)return notify('此版本最多支持 5 座塔');state.towerFloors.push(11);updateTowerUI();buildParam()};for(let key of ['floorHeight','thickness','setback','random','attach','seed','bridgeWidth','connections']){let input=$(key);input.addEventListener(key==='connections'?'change':'input',e=>{state.params[key]=key==='connections'?e.target.value:Number(e.target.value);let output=$(key+'O');if(output)output.textContent=key==='random'||key==='attach'?e.target.value+'%':key==='bridgeWidth'?Number(e.target.value).toFixed(2)+'×':Number(e.target.value).toFixed(2)+' m';buildParam()})}updateTowerUI();document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['INPUT','TEXTAREA','SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName))return;if(e.key==='1')preset('iso');if(e.key==='2')preset('top');if(e.key==='3')preset('front');if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();$('play').click()}});let drag=null;for(let [name,side] of [['splitL','left'],['splitR','right']]){let s=$(name);s.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{s.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);drag={side,x:e.clientX}});s.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag||drag.side!==side)return;let w=side==='left'?e.clientX:window.innerWidth-e.clientX;document.documentElement.style.setProperty(side==='left'?'--left':'--right',clamp(w,220,460)+'px');resize()});s.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=null);s.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=null)}}
function updateStyleButtons(id){for(let x of ['displayReal','displayWhite','displayLines'])$(x).classList.toggle('primary',x===id)}
try{init()}catch(e){console.error(e);loading('三维引擎无法启动',String(e?.message||e)+'\n请检查浏览器是否支持 WebGL 2。',true)}
</script></body></html>
